verdict.rationale: Docs describe a generic 'point a tool at a model and start it' single-command integration and specifically mention wiring the `opencode` CLI with a `--cloud`/local flag (docs-7, docs-16), which matches the story's intent. However, evidence only names one third-party agent CLI, lacks a broader roster of 'popular' coding agents supported, and there is no independent/hands-on confirmation that this specific flow works reliably. Missing for 10: list of multiple popular coding-agent CLIs supported, hands-on/community verification of the one-command launch flow, and details on how local model config is auto-injected into each tool.
